title: Keen to get Alexa+ but don’t have the necessary hardware? These are the 9 Amazon devices we recommend to get you…
excerpt: From bedside smart speakers to screen-toting home hubs, there are multiple ways to get Alexa+ into your home
content_html:
The news that Amazon’s smarter AI assistant, Alexa+, is finally making its way to Australia could well be exciting news for many Aussies. After all, we’ve had to wait a fair amount of time for the upgraded digital assistant, as it launched in the US way back in February 2025, and arrived on UK shores in March of this year.

If you’re already embedded in Amazon’s ecosystem, whether that be through ownership of Echo smart speakers and displays or Ring home security cameras, you’d be forgiven for thinking Alexa+ might never make it Down Under. If so, you may have never felt the need to upgrade your various Amazon devices to newer generations.

Now with the official rollout of Alexa+ in Australia, that could mean your devices aren’t compatible. In truth, the list of incompatible devices is relatively short (which I have to say is quite remarkable and deserves brownie points for Amazon), but regardless, the latest generation Alexa-enabled devices will offer the best Alexa+ experience.

So, if you want to add Alexa+ to your home to become an AI-powered digital assistant capable of performing all manner of tasks, from answering simple queries to placing Amazon orders on your behalf or even notifying you when packages are delivered to your home (and are captured on a Ring camera), then any of these nine Echo devices will be worthy additions to your home.

Also note that you'll need a subscription to Alexa+. It's free if you're already a Prime member, otherwise it costs AU$29.99p/m. Considering an Amazon Prime membership is just AU$9.99p/m, you'd be saving money.

Max is a senior staff writer for TechRadar who covers home entertainment and audio first, NBN second and virtually anything else that falls under the consumer electronics umbrella third. He's also a bit of an ecommerce fiend, particularly when it comes to finding the latest coupon codes for a variety of publications. He has written for TechRadar's sister publication What Hi-Fi? as well as Pocket-lint, and he's also the editor of Australian Hi-Fi and Audio Esoterica magazines. Max also dabbled in the men's lifestyle publication space, but is now firmly rooted in his first passion of technology.

content_html_zh:
亚马逊更智能的人工智能助手 Alexa+ 终于登陆澳大利亚的消息对许多澳大利亚人来说可能是一个令人兴奋的消息。 毕竟，我们已经等了相当长的时间才能看到升级后的数字助理，因为它早在 2025 年 2 月就在美国推出，并于今年 3 月抵达英国海岸。

如果你已经融入了亚马逊的生态系统，无论是通过拥有 Echo 智能扬声器和显示器还是 Ring 家庭安全摄像头，你会认为 Alexa+ 可能永远不会进入澳大利亚，这是情有可原的。 如果是这样，您可能从未觉得有必要将您的各种亚马逊设备升级到新一代。

现在，随着 Alexa+ 在澳大利亚正式推出，这可能意味着您的设备不兼容。 事实上，不兼容设备的列表相对较短（我不得不说这是非常了不起的，值得亚马逊加分），但无论如何，最新一代支持 Alexa 的设备将提供最佳的 Alexa+ 体验。

因此，如果你想将 Alexa+ 添加到你的家中，成为一个人工智能驱动的数字助理，能够执行各种任务，从回答简单的查询到代表你在亚马逊下订单，甚至在包裹送到你家时通知你（并用 Ring 相机拍摄），那么这九款 Echo 设备中的任何一款都值得添加到你的家中。

另请注意，您需要订阅 Alexa+。 如果您已经是 Prime 会员，则免费，否则费用为 AU$29.99p/m。 考虑到亚马逊 Prime 会员资格只需 AU$9.99p/m，你就省钱了。

Max 是 TechRadar 的高级撰稿人，他首先涵盖家庭娱乐和音频，其次是 NBN，最后是消费电子产品领域的几乎所有其他内容。 他还是一位电子商务爱好者，尤其是在寻找各种出版物的最新优惠券代码时。 他为 TechRadar 的姊妹刊物《什么是 Hi-Fi？》撰稿。 以及 Pocket-lint，他还是澳大利亚 Hi-Fi 和 Audio Esoterica 杂志的编辑。 Max 还涉足了男性生活方式出版领域，但现在他的最初热情深深植根于技术。
